paragraphs.source_en: “If the animals in front are continually changing and the direction of the whole herd is constantly altered, this is because in order to follow a given direction the animals transfer their will to the animals that have attracted our attention, and to study the movements of the herd we must watch the movements of all the prominent animals moving on all sides of the herd.” So say the third class of historians who regard all historical persons, from monarchs to journalists, as the expression of their age.

units.source_en: So say the third class of historians who regard all historical persons, from monarchs to journalists, as the expression of their age.

paragraphs.source_en: The theory of the transference of the will of the people to historic persons is merely a paraphrase—a restatement of the question in other words.

units.source_en: The theory of the transference of the will of the people to historic persons is merely a paraphrase—a restatement of the question in other words.

paragraphs.source_en: What causes historical events? Power. What is power? Power is the collective will of the people transferred to one person. Under what condition is the will of the people delegated to one person? On condition that that person expresses the will of the whole people. That is, power is power: in other words, power is a word the meaning of which we do not understand.

units.source_en: What causes historical events?
Power.
What is power?
Power is the collective will of the people transferred to one person.
Under what condition is the will of the people delegated to one person?
On condition that that person expresses the will of the whole people.
That is, power is power: in other words, power is a word the meaning of which we do not understand.

paragraphs.source_en: If the realm of human knowledge were confined to abstract reasoning, then having subjected to criticism the explanation of “power” that juridical science gives us, humanity would conclude that power is merely a word and has no real existence. But to understand phenomena man has, besides abstract reasoning, experience by which he verifies his reflections. And experience tells us that power is not merely a word but an actually existing phenomenon.

paragraphs.source_en: Not to speak of the fact that no description of the collective activity of men can do without the conception of power, the existence of power is proved both by history and by observing contemporary events.

units.source_en: Not to speak of the fact that no description of the collective activity of men can do without the conception of power, the existence of power is proved both by history and by observing contemporary events.

paragraphs.source_en: Whenever an event occurs a man appears or men appear, by whose will the event seems to have taken place. Napoleon III issues a decree and the French go to Mexico. The King of Prussia and Bismarck issue decrees and an army enters Bohemia. Napoleon I issues a decree and an army enters Russia. Alexander I gives a command and the French submit to the Bourbons. Experience shows us that whatever event occurs it is always related to the will of one or of several men who have decreed it.
